t0014-01.gloss: A tire drawing and dark groove residue accompany a repair tool.
t0014-01.rival_reading: A road crew could inspect tires after a closure and keep a service slip with its tools; the dust does not identify where it came from.

t0014-02.gloss: A county tire charge is incomplete, with a note delaying public accounting.
t0014-02.rival_reading: A shop could hold one tire aside during inventory after a road closure; the private bicycle request may be ordinary family borrowing.
